Create notification API endpoints including GET /api/notifications for user notifications with pagination, PUT /api/notifications/:id/read for marking as read, POST /api/notifications for creating notifications (internal use), and DELETE /api/notifications/:id for notification cleanup. Ensure proper RLS policies for both tables to respect company-level data isolation and user permissions.

tasks.title: Fix Billing Report API Endpoint Access Control
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive role-based access control for billing report endpoints, allowing all authenticated users to access their own billing data while maintaining security boundaries and proper authorization checks.
tasks.details: Analyze current billing report API endpoints in apps/web/app/api/billing/report/route.ts and identify access control gaps. Implement role-based middleware that allows all authenticated users (Admin, Manager, User) to access their own billing data while preventing unauthorized access to other users' data. Implement proper error handling for unauthorized access attempts with appropriate HTTP status codes. Add request validation to ensure billing report queries are scoped to the authenticated user's company and accessible projects. Update the billing report service layer to include user-specific filtering and ensure RLS policies are properly enforced. Add comprehensive logging for billing data access attempts for security auditing. Test with different user roles to ensure proper access boundaries are maintained while allowing legitimate access to personal billing data.
tasks.testStrategy: Test billing report API access with Admin, Manager, and User roles to verify each can access their own billing data. Verify unauthorized access attempts return proper 403/404 errors. Test cross-company data isolation to ensure users cannot access billing data from other companies. Validate that users can only see billing reports for projects they have access to. Test API endpoint security with malformed requests and unauthorized tokens. Verify proper error handling and logging for failed access attempts. Test performance impact of additional authorization checks on billing report generation.

tasks.title: Implement Comprehensive Role Management System with Hierarchy
tasks.description: Build a sophisticated role hierarchy system with Super Admin, System Admin, Company Admin, Manager, and User roles, implementing permission-based elevation capabilities and strict role hierarchy enforcement across all application features.
tasks.details: Extend the existing role system by creating a hierarchical role structure with five distinct levels: Super Admin (system-wide access), System Admin (cross-company technical access), Company Admin (full company access), Manager (team/project access), and User (basic access). Implement role hierarchy table with parent-child relationships and permission inheritance. Create permission system with granular capabilities (create, read, update, delete, manage) for each resource type (users, projects, tickets, billing, settings). Build role elevation system allowing temporary permission escalation with approval workflows and audit logging. Implement role-based middleware that checks hierarchy permissions before resource access. Create admin interfaces for role assignment, permission management, and elevation request handling. Update all existing RLS policies to incorporate the new role hierarchy. Build role delegation system allowing higher-level roles to temporarily grant permissions to subordinates. Implement comprehensive audit logging for all role changes and permission escalations. Ensure backward compatibility with existing Admin/Manager/User roles by mapping them to the new hierarchy.
tasks.testStrategy: Test role hierarchy enforcement across all application features ensuring users can only access resources appropriate to their role level. Verify permission inheritance works correctly from parent to child roles. Test role elevation workflows including request submission, approval process, and automatic expiration. Validate that role changes are properly audited and logged. Test cross-role scenarios ensuring Super Admins can manage all companies while Company Admins are restricted to their own company. Verify RLS policies correctly filter data based on role hierarchy. Test role delegation functionality with proper authorization checks. Ensure all existing functionality continues to work with legacy role mappings. Test permission escalation scenarios and verify they expire correctly. Validate that role hierarchy cannot be bypassed through API manipulation.

tasks.title: Fix React Query Cache Invalidation Across Application
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive query invalidation patterns to ensure real-time data updates across ticket creation, time tracking, user management, and billing operations with proper cache synchronization.
tasks.details: Audit all existing React Query implementations across the application to identify cache invalidation gaps. Implement comprehensive invalidation patterns including: 1) Ticket operations - invalidate tickets list, project tickets, and user assignments on create/update/delete operations; 2) Time tracking - invalidate time entries, project totals, user totals, and billing calculations on time entry changes; 3) User management - invalidate user lists, company users, project assignments, and role-based queries on user updates; 4) Billing operations - invalidate billing reports, rate calculations, project billing, and invoice data on rate or time entry changes. Create utility functions for batch invalidation of related queries, implement optimistic updates with proper rollback mechanisms, add query prefetching for anticipated user actions, ensure proper error boundaries for failed invalidations, and implement selective invalidation to avoid unnecessary re-fetches. Add debugging tools to track cache state and invalidation events during development.
tasks.testStrategy: Test cache invalidation for each feature area ensuring data consistency across components. Verify optimistic updates rollback correctly on API failures. Test concurrent operations to ensure proper cache synchronization. Validate that related queries are properly invalidated (e.g., creating a ticket invalidates project ticket list, user assignment queries, etc.). Test performance impact of invalidation patterns under high load. Verify cache debugging tools provide accurate state information. Test offline/online scenarios with proper cache reconciliation.
